title: Refuse a brief or a new session for a roadmap step that another live session already carries
why: Coordinator 15:00 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: at 11:45 CST it routed step draft-pr-guard-heredoc to [ended:draft-pr-guard-heredoc], while [ended:draft-pr-guard-heredoc] already ran that step and had handed #1820, #1863, #1897 and #1915. The duplicate is archived; branch archive/draft-pr-guard-heredoc-restart holds its work. Red case: a create_session or brief for a cs-step tag that a live session already carries is refused, naming that session.
note: Sighting (coordinator 15:42 CST Nov 8): it started lane [ended:Lane:-review-state-guard-needs-round-3] for step review-state-guard-needs-round-3, whose PR #2252 already existed. The check should read a step's handed PR too, not only live sessions. Sighting (coordinator 18:49 CST Nov 8): two lanes on Nov 8 could not find triage through list_sessions, though get_session shows triage tagged cs-build:triage and cs-repo:shivinate7/claude-settings. PR #2416 (coordinator, 05:13 CST Nov 9, named as step-dup-check). Notes on #2416: (1) the two-page chain accumulation of `listed` has no test; (2) an upper-case step in _live_with_step has no test; (3) _step_held_hit defaults rows and records to fail open for a future caller; (4) two test comments call controls green on the old code that were red there. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL2hXLvodLuczRGgNHP.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10). Widened by ruling backlog-drain-plan, part 1 (owner 10:45 CST Nov 13): refuse a lane brief or a new session for a step that has an open lane PR, unless the brief says "continues #N" or "replaces #N". Lane started by the coordinator 10:48 CST Nov 13 (R66 part 1). Express (owner 10:54 CST Nov 13, ruling drain-first-hold part 4): goes ahead of the drain.
